scientific_integrity: The general parameter theorem follows from analytic generator and hypergeometric-moment identities; exact finite enumeration is supporting verification, not a substitute for proof. Relevant literature comparisons are qualified by access limits.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous cycle, fixed particle number and strictly positive clockwise and counterclockwise rates; event-Palm empty-site spells only. Only the initial hazard slope is classified; no all-time hazard or experimental sample-complexity claim. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: A sharp drift threshold for initial vacancy-hazard acceleration in finite exclusion rings
